title: LAUNCHES from Iran as the IRGC unleashes SECOND WAVE of missiles targeting US bases across the GULF
text:
LAUNCHES from Iran as the IRGC unleashes SECOND WAVE of missiles targeting US bases across the GULF"

"EXPLOSIONS reported in Bahrain & Kuwait minutes later"

"==========="

"🔆🔅Details of the Attack on 8 Cities in Khuzestan; Guard Killed at Agricultural Water Pumping Station"

"Statement by the Deputy Governor of Khuzestan:"

"- At 1:35 AM today (Monday, July 13th), two locations on the outskirts of Ahvaz (the provincial capital, located in central Khuzestan) were struck by enemy projectiles."

"- At 1:40 AM, locations in the cities of Behbahan (in the eastern part of the province) and Dezful (in the northern part of the province) were hit by enemy projectiles."

"- At 1:45 AM, four locations in the cities of Omidieh and Mahshahr (both in the southern part of the province, near the Persian Gulf coast) were struck."

"- As a result of this early-morning enemy attack, a projectile hit the agricultural water pumping station in Mahshahr. Unfortunately, one guard was martyred and four other people were injured."

"- At 2:00 AM, a location in the city of Andimeshk (in the northern part of the province, near Dezful) was hit. Then, at 2:20 AM, locations in the cities of Abadan and Shadegan (both in the southwestern part of the province, near the border with Iraq) were targeted by airstrikes."

"- Denials: The Deputy Governor firmly denied reports of any strike on the Shalamcheh border terminal (a major border crossing with Iraq, located near the city of Khorramshahr). He also stated that reports of a projectile hitting Ahvaz International Airport are not true; he clarified that the two reported impacts in Ahvaz were strictly on the outskirts of the city, not at the airport itself.
